questions.instructions: `hook` is the one-line summary of a stored memory note and `body` is the full note. Does the note assert that a tool, command or feature does NOT work, or cannot do something, without naming a version or a date that would let a reader re-test the claim?

criteria.true: it makes a negative claim about a tool with no version or date to re-test it against
criteria.false: it makes no such claim, or the claim names a version or a date

questions.instructions: `hook` is the one-line summary of a stored memory note and `body` is the full note. Does the note describe a session or attempt that never reached a working end state, without labelling the problem as unsolved or open?

criteria.true: the attempt it describes never worked, and nothing in the note marks it unsolved
criteria.false: it describes a working end state, or it is explicitly labelled unsolved or open
